column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS records to SPDX 3.0.1

# mapping_set_description: Class-level mappings between the records of an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS and the classes of SPDX 3.0.1 that lmodel/spdx models. Each row maps a class of this schema to a class of the released lmodel/spdx v0.1.0 schema asset, which tests/neighbours/ holds, named by the IRI the released copy gives it. The rows were first drafted by a language model and then each was checked against both classes' descriptions; a row whose object no released copy holds, or whose meaning did not hold, was dropped. They await review by a person.
